text:
samir: Need a prod press for release v2.3.1 — KV cache hotfix + small routing tweak. Change window 17:00-18:00 PT. Who can press? @reena @maria?
reena: I can press at 17:05. Do we have a pinned model-serving artifact? Also need MFA on the deploy action (company policy).
maria: I can sign off remotely. Confirm pining: we should pin model-serving@1.9.4 before canary. Also want a quick smoke checklist in the release notes.
samir: Plan: pin model-serving@1.9.4 -> canary 10% for 15m -> full roll. Rollback criteria: latency > 200ms P95 or errors > 2% for 5m -> immediate rollback to 1.9.3.
aj: ops note: we should request temporary deploy role for reena if she needs to press from laptop. Approvals only for the window. Who's owning post-canary monitoring?
reena: I have monitoring. If ops grants JIT role, I can press and watch. @aj can you open the temporary grant?
aj: opsbot: request temp-deploy-role for reena (expires 2026-06-01T18:30:00Z) — reason: press for v2.3.1 canary.
opsbot: APPROVED by rota-owner (token id xYz-12). JIT grant active until 2026-06-01T18:30:00Z. Note: MFA required on activation.
reena: activating now, doing MFA.
deploy-bot: Requested deploy token for @reena. Run the following to press:
```
deploy-bot press --release v2.3.1 --pin model-serving@1.9.4 --canary 10% --notes "KV cache + routing fix; smoke checklist in release PR"
```
reena: pressing in 30s. I'll start canary then monitor dashboards (latency, 5xx, qps).
reena: pressed. deploy-bot: started canary rollout at 2026-06-01T17:05:12Z.
deploy-bot: Canary update: 10% traffic, healthy. 5m check: p95 latency 145ms, errors 0.6%.
samir: nice. hold for 10 more minutes, then go to 50% if stable.
maria: :thumbsup: approving progression to 50% after the 15m smoke.
reena: moving to 50% now. deploy-bot: scaled canary to 50% at 2026-06-01T17:21:03Z.
deploy-bot: Canary 50% metrics: p95 160ms, errors 0.8% — within thresholds.
aj: adding a note to release notes: link https://git.company/release/v2.3.1 with smoke checklist and rollback steps.
samir: unless anyone objects, finalize to 100% in 5. If something spikes we rollback.
maria: no objections.
reena: promoting to 100% now. deploy-bot: promotion started at 2026-06-01T17:28:10Z.
deploy-bot: Promotion completed — 100% traffic on model-serving@1.9.4.
deploy-bot: Post-release health check 5m: p95 170ms, errors 1.1%. OK.
samir: thanks everyone. Note to oncall: keep an eye for related error spikes for next 2 hours. I'll update the changelog and pin in the registry.
aj: closing temp grant for reena now. opsbot: revoking JIT grant.
opsbot: JIT grant revoked at 2026-06-01T18:02:05Z.
reena: got it. all good from my side.
samir: leaving release notes + pinned artifact info in #releases and internal registry. Good job. :tada:
